ui.coachIntro: Hi! I'm Kirill, a coach. I picked these recipes so you eat tasty food and still move toward your goal. If you want a training and nutrition program built for you, with my support, message me.
tips: Protein at every meal makes it easier not to overeat.
Cook twice a week for 3-4 days instead of from scratch every day.
Don't slash calories: slow progress lasts longer.
Weigh in the morning 2-3 times a week and watch the trend, not one day.
ui.coachSoon: The coach's contacts will appear here soon.

1: basil pasta tomato sauce: 360 g (1 jar)
cream cheese or 5% cottage cheese: 160 g
light cheese, grated: 100 g (3 matchbox-sized pieces)
dried garlic and onion, pepper, paprika, Provençal herbs, parsley, dill, salt
Put the whole chicken fillets in a heavy pot, add the tomato sauce, cream, cream cheese and all the spices. Simmer covered for 40-50 minutes.
Shred the chicken with forks right in the sauce.
Add the spinach 5 minutes before the end (earlier and it overcooks).
Stir in the cooked pasta (boil it 1-2 minutes less than the package says).
Pour in the milk and stir until creamy. Mix in half of the cheese, sprinkle the rest on top and cover for 15 minutes.
Keeps in the fridge for 3 days, freeze the rest. Thaw overnight in the fridge. Reheat 1.5 minutes in the microwave, stir.
2: Beef Pasta with Peppers and Two Cheeses
pasta (shells or any durum): 225 g dry
Italian herbs, smoked paprika, chili flakes, dried garlic, pepper, salt
Chop the peppers and tomatoes roughly, mince the garlic. Fry in a dry pan over high heat with the spices for 8-10 minutes until the pepper darkens at the edges. Set aside.
Boil the pasta 2 minutes less than the package says.
Put the beef in the same pan, break up the lumps and fry with spices until the liquid is gone.
Return the vegetables to the beef, add the processed cheese and grated light cheese, stir until melted.
Mix in the pasta and divide into 4 containers.
Keeps in the fridge for 3 days, freeze the rest. Thaw overnight in the fridge. Reheat 1.5 minutes in the microwave, stir. Add a spoon of milk on top before reheating.
Calories and protein are estimated from the ingredients; the author did not show them.
3: pasta (fettuccine or any durum): 220 g dry
dried garlic, Italian herbs, smoked paprika, pepper, salt
Season the whole fillets with paprika, garlic, salt and pepper. Bake at 200 °C for 20-25 minutes until done.
Hard-boil the eggs (10 minutes) and peel them.
Boil the pasta 2 minutes less than the package says.
Blend the cottage cheese, boiled eggs, grated cheese, milk, garlic, herbs, salt and pepper until smooth.
Let the pasta cool slightly and stir in the sauce. Don't heat the sauce, or the cottage cheese will curdle.
Slice the chicken into strips. Pack the pasta with sauce in containers and put the chicken on top.
Keeps in the fridge for 3 days, freeze the rest. Thaw overnight in the fridge. Reheat 1.5 minutes in the microwave, stir.
4: Beef, Bacon and Sweet Pepper Pasta
bacon (any smoked, turkey is fine): 140 g
fusilli or any durum pasta: 180 g dry
sauce: Greek yogurt 350 g, milk 200 ml, light cheese 90 g, cream or processed cheese 20-40 g, Parmesan or hard cheese 20 g, honey 12 g (2 tsp), pepper
Chop the pepper and onion roughly, fry in a hot pan, season.
Add the beef to the same pan and break up the lumps.
Fry the bacon separately until crisp and add to the beef together with the rendered fat.
Boil the pasta al dente and drain.
Whisk the sauce: yogurt, milk, honey, pepper. Stir in the grated cheeses, no blender needed.
Combine everything in a pot and warm over low heat without boiling (the yogurt would curdle). Divide into 4 containers.
Keeps in the fridge for 3 days, freeze the rest. Thaw overnight in the fridge. Reheat 1.5 minutes in the microwave, stir. From frozen: 1.5 minutes, stir, another 45 seconds.
5: Baked Chicken Pasta with Caramelized Onion
chicken breast: 650 g (seasoning: 1 tsp each of paprika, garlic and onion powder, oregano, salt, pepper and ½ tsp chili)
onion: 1 large or 2 medium, in half rings (with a pinch of paprika, salt and Italian herbs)
garlic: 2 small heads (cut off the tops)
sun-dried tomatoes: 2 tbsp (or 1 tbsp tomato paste)
cream 10% (instead of light condensed milk): 250 ml
Brush the chicken and onion with oil, salt them and put in a baking dish together with the garlic heads.
Cover with foil and bake at 180 °C (fan) or 200 °C. Take out the chicken and check it is done (clear juices, 75 °C inside); return for 5-10 minutes if needed. Shred with forks.
Add the sun-dried tomatoes to the dish and put the onion and garlic back in the oven for 10-20 minutes until caramelized (wrap the garlic in foil if it isn't ready).
In the warm dish stir in the cream, cream cheese, Parmesan and parsley into a creamy mass.
Add the cooked pasta (al dente) and the chicken, squeeze in the lemon, stir and divide into containers.
Keeps in the fridge for 3 days, freeze the rest. Thaw overnight in the fridge. Reheat 1.5 minutes in the microwave, stir.
6: One-Dish Chicken, Rice and Broccoli Bake
basmati rice (or any long-grain), rinsed: 200 g dry (1 cup)
garlic and onion powder 1 tsp each, salt, pepper
Put the raw rinsed rice, chicken, pesto, yogurt, broccoli, stock and spices in a large baking dish.
Mix well so the rice is fully under the liquid. Spread the mozzarella on top.
Cover tightly with foil and bake 45-55 minutes until the chicken is cooked and the rice is soft.
Remove the foil and bake 10-15 more minutes until golden. Divide into 4 servings.
Keeps in the fridge for 3 days, freeze the rest. About 5 g of fiber per serving.
7: Chicken Noodles with Vegetables in Asian Sauce
carrot: 100 g, onion: 100 g, green onion: 20 g
sauce: soy 60 g, oyster sauce 40 g (substitute: more soy + a pinch of sugar), sriracha or hot sauce 15 g, garlic 12 g, ginger 10 g
cornstarch: 1 heaping tsp, dissolved in 50 ml cold water
for the chicken: smoked paprika, dried garlic and onion, black pepper, salt
Boil the noodles 1 minute less than the package says and rinse with cold water, otherwise they go soggy over a few days.
Cube the chicken, coat in the spices and fry in a dry very hot pan in batches, 6-8 minutes, until browned. Set aside.
Slice the mushrooms roughly and fry over high heat until the water evaporates. Add julienned carrot, after 2 minutes the pepper and onion, 2 more minutes. Zucchini goes in for the last 3-4 minutes.
Sauce: soy, oyster, sriracha, grated garlic and ginger. Pour the starch slurry into the boiling sauce.
Return the chicken to the vegetables, pour in the sauce and warm until glossy. Take off the heat and stir in the noodles.
Divide into 4 containers, top with green onion.
Keeps in the fridge for 3 days, freeze the rest. Thaw overnight in the fridge. Reheat 1.5 minutes in the microwave, stir.
Calories and protein are estimated from the ingredients; the author did not show them.
8: Sweet and Sour Chicken with Fried Rice
sauce: sugar-free ketchup 75 g (4 tbsp), soy 40 g, honey 30 g (1.5 tbsp), sriracha 20 g, rice or apple vinegar 20 ml, garlic 10 g
soy sauce for the rice: 25 g, cornstarch 1 tsp, green onion 20 g, chicken spices
Cover the rice with water (1 cup of rice to 2.25 cups of water) and cook covered 20-25 minutes after it boils. Let it cool (hot rice clumps in the pan).
Cube the chicken, coat in spices and fry in a dry very hot pan in batches, 6-8 minutes, until browned. Set aside.
Fry the pepper and onion in large cubes over high heat for 3-4 minutes so they stay crunchy inside.
Sauce: ketchup, soy, honey, sriracha, vinegar, grated garlic. Dissolve the starch in 50 ml cold water and pour into the boiling sauce.
Return the chicken to the pepper, pour in the sauce and warm for 2-3 minutes until glossy.
In a clean pan warm the vegetable mix for 5 minutes, push to the side, pour in the eggs and scramble. Add the rice and soy sauce and stir for 3 minutes.
Divide into containers: rice with vegetables and egg, chicken in sauce on top, then green onion.
Keeps in the fridge for 3 days, freeze the rest. Thaw overnight in the fridge. Reheat 1.5 minutes in the microwave, stir.
Calories and protein are estimated from the ingredients; the author did not show them.
9: 4 servings (440 kcal each per the author)
baking powder: 4 g (1 level tsp, makes the chicken more tender)
fresh orange juice: 60 ml, soy sauce: 100 g, black pepper: 2 g, cornstarch: 12 g (1 tbsp)
sauce: garlic 6 g, ginger 6 g, sugar-free orange juice 160 ml, soy 60 g, rice or apple vinegar 24 g, sugar 14 g (3 tsp, or sweetener)
optional: orange zest, a pinch of chili flakes, 1 tsp oil
to serve: sesame, green onion, cooked rice: 320 g for all 4 servings (80 g per serving per the author; more rice means more calories)
Mix the chicken with baking powder, orange juice, soy sauce, pepper and starch, let it sit 15-20 minutes.
Fry the chicken over high heat until browned.
Mix the sauce (garlic, ginger, juice, soy, vinegar, sugar) and reduce until thick.
Combine the chicken with the sauce, warm until glossy. Serve with rice, topped with sesame and green onion.
Keeps in the fridge for 3 days, freeze the rest. Thaw overnight in the fridge. Reheat 1.5 minutes in the microwave, stir.
Only the ingredients were visible in the source, the steps are written in the standard order for this kind of dish.
10: Whisk the eggs with the cottage cheese using a fork or blender, add the grated cheese and herbs.
Pour into a non-stick pan and cook over low heat, covered, for 8-10 minutes (or 3-4 minutes in the microwave).
The steps were not visible in the source, written in the standard order.
11: vanilla protein powder: ½ scoop (15 g), without it: a spoon of milk powder or just more yogurt
sweetener or honey: 1 tbsp, vanilla ¼ tsp, cinnamon ¼ tsp
filling: fat-free Greek yogurt 85 g (⅓ cup), protein 15 g, a splash of milk, cinnamon
Whisk the egg with the milk, protein, sweetener, vanilla and cinnamon.
Dip the bread so it soaks through completely.
Fry in a greased pan 1-2 minutes per side until golden.
Mix the yogurt with the protein, add a little milk if needed.
Build the toast in layers with the filling, sprinkle cinnamon between layers and on top.
12: vanilla protein powder: 60 g (without it use finely ground oats and add more frosting)
honey: 2 tbsp, cinnamon 1 tsp, ginger and nutmeg ¼ tsp each, baking powder 1 tsp, pinch of salt
frosting: cottage cheese 225 g, Greek yogurt 30 g, honey 2 tbsp, vanilla, cinnamon
Mix all the oatmeal ingredients well in a dish about 20 × 20 cm.
Blend the frosting until smooth. Cool the oatmeal, spread the frosting on and cut into 8 pieces.
13: Cottage Cheese Semolina Cake with Cherry Jam
batter: soft 0.1% cottage cheese 200 g, semolina 50 g, 1 egg yolk, 3 egg whites, baking powder 4 g (1 tsp), milk 60 ml, sweetener to taste
jam: frozen cherries 150 g, cornstarch 4 g (½ tsp), sweetener to taste
Mix all the batter ingredients except the baking powder and whites. Let it rest 30 minutes.
Whip the whites to stiff peaks. Stir the baking powder into the batter, then gently fold in the whites.
Pour into a pan and bake at 160 °C for 30 minutes. Turn the oven off and open the door slightly.
Jam: put the cherries in a pan over medium heat and wait for the juice. Stir the starch into 30 ml water in a cup. Add sweetener, pour in the starch and stir about 1 minute until jelly-like.
Pour the jam over the cake. Cool; you can leave it in the fridge overnight and eat it in the morning (or right away).
The author counted macros for the whole pan, so divide by two for half.
14: Protein Cheesecake Bowl with Passion Fruit
vanilla protein yogurt: 160 g (substitute: Greek yogurt + 1 tsp honey + a drop of vanilla)
passion fruit pulp: 30 ml (substitute: puree of kiwi, raspberry or another tart berry)
plain dry biscuits without sugar: 4 (substitute: any dry biscuit)
maple syrup: 20 ml (substitute: 1 tsp honey or sweetener)
Mix the yogurt, lemon juice and salt.
Put in a sieve lined with cheesecloth or a clean kitchen towel over a bowl. Press lightly with a cup and refrigerate 24 hours until thick and creamy.
Before serving squeeze out lightly and layer with the crushed biscuits and fruit puree.
15: hot honey: 40 g, ours: 2 tbsp honey + 1 tsp hot sauce (sriracha, chili)
Dijon or whole-grain mustard: 15 g (1 tbsp)
garlic powder and smoked paprika ½ tsp each, salt, pepper
Put all the ingredients in a blender or a bowl with a blending attachment.
Blend until smooth and creamy, taste and adjust.
Pour into a bottle or container and refrigerate at least 30 minutes. Goes with chicken, beef and rice.
Keep refrigerated in a closed container.
16: Chicken Meatballs in Tomato Sauce with Rice
tomato passata or crushed canned tomatoes: 500 g (2 cups)
garlic 2 cloves, salt, pepper, dried basil or oregano
Cook the rice according to the package.
Mix the mince with the oats, egg, finely chopped onion, salt and pepper, shape into balls of 30-35 g.
Fry the balls in oil on all sides for 5 minutes.
Pour in the tomatoes, add the garlic and herbs, simmer covered for 15 minutes.
Divide the rice and meatballs with sauce into 4 containers.
Keeps in the fridge for 3 days, freeze the rest. Thaw overnight in the fridge. Reheat 1.5 minutes in the microwave, stir.
Macros are calculated from the ingredients, accuracy about 10%.
17: Beef Chili con Carne with Rice
tomato passata or canned tomatoes: 400 g (1.5 cups)
canned red beans, drained: 240 g (1 can)
spices: paprika 2 tsp, cumin 1 tsp, ground chili to taste, garlic 3 cloves, salt
Fry the onion and pepper in oil for 5 minutes, add the garlic and spices for 1 minute.
Add the beef, break it up with a spatula and fry until it changes color.
Pour in the tomatoes, add the beans and corn, simmer covered for 25 minutes.
Serve with cooked rice, with a spoon of yogurt on top if you like.
Keeps in the fridge for 3 days, freeze the rest. Thaw overnight in the fridge. Reheat 1.5 minutes in the microwave, stir.
If you have no red beans, any canned beans work. Macros are calculated from the ingredients, accuracy about 10%.
18: Chicken Curry with Chickpeas and Rice
light coconut milk (substitute: 2.5% milk + 1 tsp oil): 200 g (¾ cup)
curry powder 1.5 tbsp, grated ginger and garlic 2 tsp each, salt, herbs
Fry the onion in oil for 4 minutes, add the ginger, garlic and curry for a minute.
Pour in the passata and coconut milk, add the chickpeas, simmer covered for 15 minutes.
Serve with rice, herbs on top.
Keeps in the fridge for 3 days, freeze the rest. Thaw overnight in the fridge. Reheat 1.5 minutes in the microwave, stir.
No coconut milk: use milk and a bit more tomato, the flavor will be lighter. Macros are calculated from the ingredients, accuracy about 10%.
19: tuna in its own juice, drained: 360 g (3 small cans)
garlic 2 cloves, chili, salt, pepper, parsley
Boil the pasta 1 minute less than the package says.
Fry the onion and garlic in oil, pour in the passata, simmer 8 minutes.
Add the tuna, olives and spices, warm 3 minutes.
Combine with the pasta and a spoon of the cooking water, grated cheese on top.
Keeps in the fridge for 3 days, freeze the rest. Thaw overnight in the fridge. Reheat 1.5 minutes in the microwave, stir.

paprika, cumin, garlic, lime or lemon, salt, pepper
Slice the chicken into strips, coat in paprika, cumin and garlic, fry until golden.
Cook the rice. Warm the beans and corn.
Sauce: yogurt, lime juice, garlic, salt.
Divide into containers by section: rice, chicken, beans with corn, tomatoes. Add the avocado and sauce just before eating.
Keeps in the fridge for 3 days. Store the avocado and sauce separately and add them fresh before eating.

Mix the mince, rice, onion, salt and spices, stuff the peppers.
Sauce: passata with sour cream and a pinch of salt. Put the peppers in a dish and pour the sauce over.
Cover with foil and bake 40 minutes at 190 °C, then sprinkle with cheese and bake 10 more minutes.
Keeps in the fridge for 3 days, freeze the rest. Thaw overnight in the fridge. Reheat 1.5 minutes in the microwave, stir.

22: Oven Chicken with Potatoes and Vegetables
chicken breast or skinless thighs: 700 g
Greek yogurt for the marinade: 120 g (½ cup)
paprika, granulated garlic, salt, pepper, dried herbs
Mix the chicken with the yogurt and spices, leave 20 minutes.
Cut the potatoes into wedges and the vegetables roughly, toss everything with oil and salt.
Spread everything on a baking tray in one layer, bake 40-45 minutes at 200 °C, stirring once.
Keeps in the fridge for 3 days, freeze the rest. Thaw overnight in the fridge. Reheat 1.5 minutes in the microwave, stir.
The simplest recipe in the collection, for when you have no energy to cook. Macros are calculated from the ingredients, accuracy about 10%.
23: Fry the beef with the onion, pour in the passata and simmer 10 minutes with the spices.
Mix the cottage cheese with the egg and salt.
Layer in a dish: lavash, meat, cottage cheese mixture, repeat.
Grate the mozzarella on top. Bake 25 minutes at 190 °C until browned.
Keeps in the fridge for 3 days, freeze the rest. Thaw overnight in the fridge. Reheat 1.5 minutes in the microwave, stir.

24: Shrimp with Fried Rice and Vegetables
Cook the rice ahead and let it cool (cold rice fries better).
Chop the vegetables small and fry over high heat for 4 minutes, add the garlic and ginger.
Push the vegetables aside, crack in the eggs and stir until done. Add the shrimp for 3 minutes.
Stir in the rice and soy sauce, warm through. Green onion on top.
Keeps in the fridge up to 2 days.
Better not to keep shrimp in a container longer than 2 days. Macros are calculated from the ingredients, accuracy about 10%.
25: Fry the onion and mushrooms in oil until the water evaporates.
Add the mince, fry 8 minutes, pour in the sour cream with garlic and simmer 5 minutes.
Mix with the buckwheat and dill.
Keeps in the fridge for 3 days, freeze the rest. Thaw overnight in the fridge. Reheat 1.5 minutes in the microwave, stir.
Macros are calculated from the ingredients, accuracy about 10%.

Fry the onion and pepper in oil for 5 minutes, add the garlic and spices.
Pour in the passata, simmer 7 minutes.
Make wells, crack in the eggs, cover and cook 5-7 minutes.
Feta and herbs on top, serve with bread.
Macros are calculated from the ingredients, accuracy about 10%.

oil for the pan: 8 g (1.5 tsp)
Greek yogurt to serve: 100 g (⅓ cup)
Grind the oats into flour in a blender.
Mix the cottage cheese, egg, flour, honey, vanilla and salt, shape 6 patties.
Fry in a lightly greased pan 3 minutes per side over medium heat.
Want even more protein: replace the flour with 30 g protein powder and 20 g oats. Macros are calculated from the ingredients, accuracy about 10%.
28: With protein add: vanilla protein powder (together with the flour): 25 g (1 scoop)
